delta_t_note: For the T sweep, delta_t is derived from the full solar time span divided by an equivalent global step count. Per-task num_discrete_steps is then computed inside the original 10-task solar scripts using that step_size.
accuracy_note: RMSE/NLL are produced by the repository's existing scripts/onedim/solar/test_hsgp_online_fixedkernel.py and scripts/onedim/solar/test_ohsgp_analytic_solar.py evaluation logic, aggregated over the 10 solar tasks.
flops_note: estimated_flops comes from torch.profiler(with_flops=True) on a single forward or forward-backward-step call. These are profiler estimates rather than hardware peak FLOPS.
